theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → v₀ ∈ V → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Euclid d), 0 < δ ∧ closedBall v₀ δ ⊆ V ∧ IsOpen O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g O ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball v₀ δ, ∀ n : Euclid P, (fderiv ℝ ψ v).range.starProjection n = 0 → ‖n‖ < δ → ψ v + n ∈ O ∧ g (ψ v + n) = v
